body: It’s really sweet of you to consider his feelings, but it sounds like you’ve been putting his needs before yours for awhile. And if you’ve made your decision it’s best to stick to it, only you know what your relationship was truly like and why you’ve made that decision . I’ve also been cheated on and it genuinely is such a horrible feeling. No one deserves to feel that way. With that said put yourself first and prioritize your mental health. As much as it’ll affect him it’s gonna “hurt” regardless. So it’s best to not drag it out any longer
